_capital_note: EDIT ME — placeholder. Set real trading capital so sizing is in rupees.

risk._risk_per_trade_note: capital risked if stopped out; drives sizing (CLAUDE.md Rule 4). Position value then hard-capped at max_pct_per_trade.

universe._kse100_top_n_note: full KSE100 (was 50 — excluded real constituents like KAPCO, breaking search/coverage for a product users expect to be complete). Deterministic layer is free regardless of size; only Room DEBATES are token-budgeted (config/room.json deep_dives_per_day), unaffected by this.
universe._cover_all_listed_note: Adds every remaining KSE All Share constituent as tier=listed, so no listed company is invisible or unsearchable (BBFL was missing entirely). tier=core keeps the expensive analysis (deep history, backtests, Desk Room); tier=listed gets prices, quant, sector and dividends plus a real page. Scripts that are expensive per ticker MUST filter to tier==core.

liquidity._research_note: RESEARCH gate, not an execution gate. A listed name clearing this (and research_min_bars) gets the full pipeline — backtests, fundamentals, predictability, fair value — so its page carries real analysis. Deliberately looser than risk.min_avg_daily_traded_value_pkr because analysing a name and being willing to trade it are different questions.
liquidity._bars_note: ~2 years. Below this a backtest is too short a sample to mean anything; the name keeps prices/quant/sector/dividends and an honest 'not enough history' note.
liquidity._gate_separation_note: TWO gates, on purpose. research_* decides what the desk ANALYSES. risk.min_avg_daily_traded_value_pkr (30M) decides what the desk will SIGNAL. A name can be researched and still never produce a setup — that is the intended outcome for thin names, and the ticker page says so rather than going silently blank.

alerts._note: Create bot via @BotFather on Telegram, paste token + your chat id. Empty = alerts logged to state/alerts.json only.
